info.title: Mane Man API: the ops console
info.description: mm-api on the ops console's host (docs/decisions/0026-hosts-and-surfaces.md), served at https://{host}/api/*, behind Cloudflare Access. Every call needs a valid Access token and is recorded in the audit log under its identity (docs/decisions/0031-access-and-audit.md). Every response carries an X-Request-Id header.

fields.description: invalid_request: the fields that failed validation, never their values; superseded: what changed under the caller.

technician.description: Their first name, and nothing else of theirs

at.description: When ops moved the job to them; null when it was moved in FSM itself

moved.description: superseded, to a technician's phone, for a job given to another technician: whom, and when (docs/open-points.md, item 92).

version_id.description: Cloudflare Worker version ID serving this request.

version_tag.description: Tag given at upload: the git commit SHA in remote environments.

d1.description: ok: reachable and marked as this environment's database. unmarked: no identity row. mismatch: marked as another environment's database.

cron_completed_at.description: When the five-minute cron last finished a run; null before its first, or when the database is not this environment's. Information only: status does not depend on it.

path.description: The page's path, with no query or fragment.

source.description: The script the error was thrown in.

code.description: outbox_gave_up: the code the API refused it with.

request_id.description: outbox_gave_up: the refusal's request ID, which its own log lines carry.

more.description: More than 20 match: narrow the search.

text.description: Any part of a name, or of a number typed any of the usual ways.

mobile.description: E.164, as ops need it to call or message.

known_since.description: When the person's record was first written.

address.description: The address visits go to now.

credits.description: Service visits left and when the soonest expires; null with none left.

visits.description: Upcoming soonest first; past newest first.

payments.description: Payments and refunds as one list, newest first.

invite.description: The invite they came with, or ops attached; null for none.

held_bookings.description: Bookings FSM refused, waiting for a try or for ops; the soonest visit first.

building.description: The building as chosen from the suggestions; null if typed.

by.description: The Access e-mail of the member of staff who saved it.

given_to_ops.description: Where the client gave it to ops on the phone: who saved it, and when.

stage.description: For a visit FSM has not closed: still to come, under way (the technician has checked in, whatever FSM says), closed as done from the technician's phone, or otherwise over and waiting for FSM to close it. Null once FSM has closed it.

prepaid.description: Paid for ahead, or covered by a visit credit: board C1's Prepaid.

place.description: The saved address's area, city and pincode, else FSM's city and pincode.

outcome.description: What FSM closed the visit as, a no-show being its own; null until it is closed.

reason.description: Null once the client is erased.

closed_without_follow_up.description: For a visit left partly done, ops closing its task without a follow-up visit; null otherwise.

amount_off.description: In paise before GST; null until the visit's price is known.

discount_code.description: The discount code on the visit (docs/decisions/0108-discount-codes.md); else null.

price_open.description: Not yet paid for, linked or invoiced, so a discount code may still be entered on it or taken off.

requested_code.description: For a consultation and fit in one visit, the code the client typed on /book for it, honoured as it stood then when entered on the visit; null for none.

stage.description: For a visit FSM has not closed: still to come, under way (the technician has checked in, whatever FSM says), closed as done from the technician's phone, or otherwise over and waiting for FSM to close it. Null once FSM has closed it.

prepaid.description: Paid for ahead, or covered by a visit credit: board C1's Prepaid.

place.description: The saved address's area, city and pincode, else FSM's city and pincode.

date.description: India's calendar date it was made.

amount.description: In paise, GST included: the main figure.

amount_ex_gst.description: In paise, before GST; null where no rate was recorded for it.

gst_percent.description: The GST rate the amount includes; null where none was recorded.

visit.description: The visit it paid for, when known.

date.description: India's day the visit was held for.

under_way.description: Still being booked; false once refunded or let go.

booking.description: What it paid for while there is no visit yet: the booking its hold was making.

method.description: upi, card, netbanking and so on.

refunded_amount.description: In paise: refunds Razorpay has processed.

purpose.description: What it paid for: the visit, or a late fee.

at.description: When the client cancelled or moved the visit.

visit_started_at.description: When the visit was to start.

charge.description: Kept under the 24-hour rule, with its evidence: "cancelled 9:14 am, visit was 10 am".

no_show.description: The visit it paid for was one the client was not home for: how long we waited, and what ops ruled (LIFE-07).

amount_off.description: In paise before GST; null where the visit's price was not yet known.

discount_code.description: The discount code the visit was paid with; null for none, and on a late fee.

decision.description: What ops ruled: undecided while they look at the evidence, charged, or waived.

waited_minutes.description: How long the technician waited at the door.

kept.description: In paise: what the charge kept of the visit's payment.

credit_spent.description: Whether the charge spent the credit the visit used.

charge.description: What the charge took, as the booking was sold to cost a no-show (ADR 0096). Null unless charged, and on a charge ruled before charges were recorded.

dispute.description: The client's dispute of the charge: open while ops look, then refunded or upheld; null when none was raised.

disputable.description: Whether the client may dispute the charge now: one that took something, not disputed yet.

date.description: India's calendar date it was made.

amount.description: In paise, GST included: the main figure.

amount_ex_gst.description: In paise, before GST; null where no rate was recorded for it.

gst_percent.description: The GST rate the amount includes; null where none was recorded.

visit.description: The visit it paid for, when known.

date.description: India's day the visit was held for.

under_way.description: Still being booked; false once refunded or let go.

booking.description: What it paid for while there is no visit yet: the booking its hold was making.

destination.description: Where the money goes back to: the payment's method.

speed.description: normal (5 to 7 working days) or instant.

visits.description: Every visit done: a completed visit with a window.

first_fit_on.description: India's date. Null when no first fit is on record, which is not the same as none.

last_visit_on.description: India's date of the latest visit done.

spend.description: In paise: every payment captured, less what has gone back. A credit adds nothing.

replacement_due.description: When the piece now in wear falls due; null when the client is wearing none.

referrer.description: Who sent it; null once they have been erased.

grant.description: pending until the client's first fit; held for ops' review; approved or granted, the reward given; rejected; expired, lapsed on a waitlist; clawed_back, the first fit refunded.

since.description: When the client first came with it, or ops attached it.

by.description: The Access identity of the member of staff who attached it.

reason.description: Null once either side is erased.

attached.description: Who attached it and why; null for an invite the client used themselves.

id.description: The booking's hold, which the three actions name.

service.description: Its service's name as it is now.

starts_at.description: When the visit it holds starts.

paid.description: In paise, GST included: what Razorpay took; 0 when a credit covers it, or it is free.

moves_visit.description: It moves a visit already booked: trying FSM again moves it, and there is no new visit to link.

held_at.description: When FSM's fifth refusal running held it.

refusal.description: FSM's latest refusal, as the log gives it.

retries_end.description: When the hourly tries end, or ended, as ops set them.

retrying.description: Still tried every hour: inside its tries, and its visit to come.

amount_off.description: In paise before GST; null until the visit's price is known.

discount_code.description: The discount code the client booked with (docs/decisions/0108-discount-codes.md).

photos.description: Before then after, each in the design's angle order.

logged_at.description: When the opening was logged, by our clock.

before.description: Who opened them before, and when, the latest first.

state.description: not_given until the client first switches it on; withdrawn once they switch it back off.

notice_version.description: The notice the client saw when they last switched it.

source.description: Where they last switched it. null when never switched, or when no place was kept: given before this release reached the environment on a notice shown in more than one place, written by the Worker it replaced between its migration and its deploy, or switched from a copy of the app loaded before it, which names no screen.

deletion.description: Their latest deletion request. A processed one leaves no client to read.

visits.description: Visits to add, or, below nought, to take away.

reason.description: correction: given or taken in error; goodwill: given to make up for something.

outcome.description: booked: in FSM and the mirror, and the client told. given_back: its payment had been refunded, or its hold lapsed, so it was let go. refused: FSM refused again, and it waits as before. to_link: a visit of the client's, of the booking's kind, reached FSM after the booking was held and is no booking's, so nothing was written; link it if it is the one ops booked.

refusal.description: FSM's refusal, as the log gives it, when it refused.

kind.description: What an earlier try left in FSM: nothing; a work order now cancelled; one FSM would not cancel, to cancel by hand; or unknown, when FSM could not be asked, so look for "(booking <id>)" among its work orders.

work_order_id.description: FSM's, where there is one to name.

visit_id.description: The visit, as the client's page lists it once FSM's webhook or the reconciliation has mirrored it: the client's, of the booking's kind, still to happen, first seen since the client paid, not the visit the booking replaces, and no other booking's.

kind.description: refunded in full now; refunded_before, by an earlier press or in Razorpay's dashboard; nothing_paid, as a free or credit booking; booked, by a try that landed meanwhile, so nothing is refunded; refund_refused by Razorpay, so nothing has gone back and the booking still waits; refund_unanswered, Razorpay would not say whether it refunded, so it may have, and the booking still waits: pressing again cannot refund twice.

payment_id.description: Razorpay's, where there is a payment.

amount.description: In paise, where one was refunded.

services.description: The kind's services offered on the first day.

pays.description: How the visit is paid for: nothing at booking (free, or a consultation and fit in one visit, paid by a link once fitted), a service-visit credit, or a payment link Razorpay texts the client.

credits.description: The service-visit credits the client has to spend.

start.description: When the window starts that day, in India's time.

technicians.description: Who is free for the visit, the client's regular technician first.

amount.description: In paise, GST included: what the client pays.

tier.description: Its code within its kind, which never changes.

minutes.description: How long the visit is booked for.

VisitService.description: The service the windows are for: the one asked, else the first.

outcome.description: booked: the visit is written. being_booked: it is on its way to the field record, within a minute. awaiting_payment: the slot is held and the link sent; the visit is booked once the client pays.

pays.description: How the visit is paid for: nothing at booking (free, or a consultation and fit in one visit, paid by a link once fitted), a service-visit credit, or a payment link Razorpay texts the client.

allOf.description: What the client pays: the service's price less any code.

link.description: The payment link Razorpay texted the client, and when it closes and the slot goes.

tier.description: The service; left out, the kind's standard one. A first fit names the hair system.

technician.description: The technician ops chose; left out, whoever is free, the client's regular one first.

one_visit.description: A consultation and fit in one visit: a first fit, morning or afternoon.

code.description: A discount code the client gave.

notice_hours.description: The notice the visit was booked under, in hours.

paid.description: In paise: what the visit's payment holds.

destination.description: The payment's method: upi, card and so on.

allOf.description: On the client's own late terms, which ops may apply with a reason.

cancelled.description: false: the terms only; true: the visit is cancelled.

refund.description: In paise: what goes back to the payment's source.

kept.description: In paise: what is kept as a charge.

credit.description: For a visit paid with a credit: whether it comes back. Lost on the client's late terms, or where its grant has been taken back or has expired; null for a visit paid otherwise.

OpsCancelOutcome.description: Free to the client: what ops cancel on unless they choose.

notice.description: With confirm: the notice ops were shown.

on_client_terms.description: With confirm: apply the client's own late terms. Left out, the cancel is free to the client.

reason.description: With confirm, required: why, kept with the cancel and never written to the audit log.

started_at.description: When the work began, on the visit's own day.

ended_at.description: When it ended: after it began, and not later than now.

reason.description: Why it is closed by hand, and, for a visit partly done, why: kept with the visit.

invite.description: The invite the client came with first.

code.description: The invite's code, in either case.

reason.description: Why, in ops' words: kept with the invite, and blanked if either side is erased.

q.description: What ops have typed so far.

session.description: One token for the whole search, sent again when the address is saved.

access_notes.description: For the technician, from the day before the visit: gate code, parking.

building.description: The building as chosen from the suggestions; null if typed.

place_id.description: Google's Place ID for the building, if one was chosen.

latest.description: The latest version; null before one.

product.description: The product, by the tier of its first-fit service: one the services table holds, retired or not.

HairFitSpec.description: Every field is sent, null where it was not taken.

remedies.description: Every remedy the client has tried, each once; none, said alone, for none. Empty: not answered.

transplant_year.description: With a transplant only, and no later than this year.

HairHistory.description: Health information the client told us: our records alone, never Zoho or a log.

id.description: The version's own ID, which a write names as based_on.

oneOf.description: The Access e-mail of the member of staff who corrected it.

visit.description: The visit it was taken at; null for a correction.

based_on.description: The id of the version the form started from: the latest as it was read; null where there was none.

HairProfileCorrection.description: The whole profile as it now stands, sent as a new version.

override_open_bookings.description: Erase even with a visit booked or a payment held: only when ops will cancel and refund them today.

reason.description: Required to reject; kept with the decision, and the client reads it (src/policy/decision-reasons.ts).

launch_on.description: India's date it starts; today if left out.

city.description: The city the jobs are narrowed to; null for all.

cities.description: The cities the board can be narrowed to.

sector.description: The area the visit's pincode is in, from the service area; else the address's locality, or the city.

person.description: Null for a visit with no client on our records, and for a client who has been erased.

badge.description: Never an amount: prepaid, credit, or free.

asked_window.description: The window the client asked for, from the Request behind the visit; null where nothing recorded one.

was_technician.description: The technician the job is still on, who was switched off and so has no row; null for a job nobody holds. A move of it names him as the expected technician.

utilisation.description: Each column's utilisation, in per cent: the slots the day's jobs take, done or still to do, out of the slots of the technicians not on leave. Written to events daily as well.

leave.description: Leave ops recorded, clipped to this week. Not from FSM: its availability answers free time, not leave.

sector.description: The area the visit's pincode is in, from the service area; else the address's locality, or the city.

person.description: Null for a visit with no client on our records, and for a client who has been erased.

badge.description: Never an amount: prepaid, credit, or free.

notice_hours.description: The notice the visit was sold under, in hours, or the one in force for a visit ops booked in FSM: a change of the client's own inside it costs them, one ops make never does.

untold.description: The latest move of this visit its client has not heard of: he has not agreed to WhatsApp, or the message was never sent. Ops call him, then POST /api/dispatch/moves/{id}/told.

begun.description: How far the technician has got, from the steps his phone sent: arrived (checked in), started, or closed (an outcome, a no-show among them). Null before he arrives. A visit he has begun, or one in progress, is not moved.

name.description: In full, as the drawer heads it.

mobile.description: E.164, for WhatsApp and for a call.

whatsapp_visits.description: His latest word on WhatsApp about his visits is yes, so a move's new window reaches him there.

referred_by.description: Who invited him, by name; null when he came on his own.

DispatchRoom.description: Each technician's day with a window the job would land in, by the check a move runs. A day not listed has none. Not where the job already is.

client_notice.description: messaged: the new window was queued to go on WhatsApp; call: the client has not agreed to WhatsApp about his visits, so ops call him, and a task waits until they say they have; unchanged: only the technician changed, so there was nothing to tell; no_client: the visit has no client on our records.

expected_technician_id.description: The technician the board showed the job with; null for a job in the tray.

expected_starts_at.description: The start the board showed the job with.

technician_id.description: Left out keeps the technician it has.

expected_technician_id.description: The technician the board showed the job with; null for a job in the tray.

expected_starts_at.description: The start the board showed the job with.

clear_check_in.description: Ops were warned that the technician has checked in, and move the visit anyway: his check-in is cleared, and he checks in again at the new time. The audit log names who chose it. Without it, a visit he has checked in at answers 409 in_progress.

waiver.description: What waiving a case gives back now, as ops set it in Settings (no_show_waiver).

person.description: Whose visit it was, so ops can open their page and call them; null once they have been erased.

checked_in_at.description: Fact one: when the technician arrived, by his phone, held within bounds. The wait ran from here.

phone_checked_in_at.description: What the phone itself said, before the bounds; null when it said nothing.

received_at.description: When the check-in reached us: long after the phone's time means no signal, or a clock set back.

minutes_late.description: Minutes from the booked start to the check-in; negative when he was early.

distance_m.description: Fact two: how far from the address he was; null where the address had no coordinates and nothing was measured.

radius_m.description: The check-in radius in force when he checked in, which the check-in keeps: the distance is read against it, not against the radius ops have set since.

message_state.description: Fact three: what became of the day-before or arrival WhatsApp. none: nothing was queued; no_consent: not sent, the client never agreed to WhatsApp about visits; not_sent: skipped or failed; sent: no receipt came back; delivered.

message_delivered_at.description: When WhatsApp reported it delivered; null if it never did.

opened_at.description: When the case opened, and started waiting for ops.

due.description: When ops should have ruled: the Tasks board's allowance for a no-show, from opened_at.

NoShowCase.description: The three facts ops rule on, and nothing else.

reason.description: Required either way, and kept with the ruling (src/policy/decision-reasons.ts).

city.description: The city he works in, which staff access by place reads; null for none.

mobile.description: The number he signs in with, +91 and ten digits; null where none is recorded.

editable.description: Whether ops change him here. While FSM is the record of field work, a technician FSM lists is changed in FSM; one ops added is theirs.

leave.description: Leave that has not ended yet, soonest first (ADR 0062).

city.description: The city he works in, which staff access by place reads; null for none.

mobile.description: The number he signs in with, +91 and ten digits; null where none is recorded.

editable.description: Whether ops change him here. While FSM is the record of field work, a technician FSM lists is changed in FSM; one ops added is theirs.

switched_off.description: Technicians switched off, by name: they cannot sign in, and nothing is booked on them.

cities.description: The cities a technician may be given, in display order.

to.description: Inclusive: a single day's leave has the same date twice.

jobs.description: The jobs already booked on those days, which the leave moves nowhere: ops move them on the dispatch board, and each waits on the Tasks board until they do (OPS-07).

note.description: Why, in ops' words. Never a medical detail.

person.description: Whose visit it was; null once they have been erased.

reason.description: Why the client says the charge is wrong, in their words; null once erased.

due.description: When ops should have ruled: the Tasks board's allowance for a no-show, from raised_at.

kept.description: In paise: what the charge kept of the visit's payment.

credit_spent.description: Whether the charge spent the credit the visit used.

window_start.description: When the visit was booked for.

radius_m.description: The check-in radius in force when he checked in.

NoShowDispute.description: A disputed charge, with the evidence its no-show was ruled on.

reason.description: Required either way, and kept on the dispute (src/policy/decision-reasons.ts).

overdue.description: How many are past their day in India, across every group.

truncated.description: More were waiting than one look reads (2000 a statement), so a count may be short.

staff.description: The members of staff a task may be given to: those who have used the console in the last 90 days, by e-mail.

count.description: How many are waiting in the group, all of them.

closable.description: Ops may close a task of the group without doing its thing, with a reason.

tasks.description: The longest wait first, at most 50.

Tasks.description: Derived at read time from the queues themselves; there is no tasks table.

id.description: The queued row's own id, so the task can be reached where it is decided.

person.description: Null for an erased client, whose record is gone.

detail.description: The one fact the group turns on: a piece's label, a fraud rule, a technician, a Books invoice, an FSM contact; for a consultation asked for, its day and window and, where a first fit was asked for with it, "first_fit" and the window wanted ("any" for either); for an at-risk client, the last visit's start and the day the next service fell due; for a first fit to book, the consultation's start and the window wanted.

due.description: since plus the group's allowance, which ops set; 48 hours until they do.

owner.description: The Access e-mail of the member of staff it is theirs; null while it is nobody's.
The Access e-mail of the member of staff it is theirs; null while it is nobody's.
A member of staff who has used the console in the last 90 days, by their Access e-mail: one's own to take the task, another's to give it to them; null to hand it back.

reason.description: Why no follow-up is booked, in ops' words: kept with the closing, blanked if the client is erased.

date.description: India's calendar date the figures cover.

collected.description: In paise. Captured on the day: the board's "Collected today".

refunds_processing.description: In paise. Asked for on the day and not back with the client yet: "Refunds processing".

refunded.description: In paise. Processed by Razorpay on the day, which the board draws no figure of its own for.

charged.description: In paise. Kept from the client on the day: "Charges and no-shows", each late cancellation and charged no-show by what it kept.

charges.description: No-shows and late cancellations, the earliest first.

OpsDayMoney.description: Derived at read time from the payments themselves; no total is kept.

id.description: The change's or the case's own id.

person.description: Null for a visit FSM never matched to one of our people.

amount.description: Null on a no-show charged before a charge recorded what it kept (migration 0059).

at.description: When the client cancelled, or when ops ruled on the no-show.

visit_started_at.description: When the visit was to start.

change.description: How the client ended the visit; null on a no-show, where they ended nothing.

technician.description: Who attended and found nobody in; null on a late cancellation.

name.description: His whole name, as clients see it.

mobile.description: The Indian mobile he signs in with; his sign-in code goes to it on WhatsApp.

zone.description: Where he mostly works, in ops' words; null for none.

city.description: The city he works in, one of GET /api/technicians' cities. Staff with a grant of that city or its zone see him; with none, only a national grant does.

visits.description: His visits still to come, now unassigned: each waits in the dispatch board's tray for ops to give it to another. A visit already begun stays his. Empty when he was switched off already.

to.description: Exclusive: the day after the last one counted.

technicians.description: Every active technician, by name, including those who finished nothing.

TechniciansWork.description: Counted at read time from the appointments themselves.

timed_jobs.description: Of those, the ones the phone timed from Start to the outcome: what the averages are the mean of.

average_minutes.description: How long those took; null when the phone timed none of them.

average_planned_minutes.description: What the same jobs were planned to take, so the two can be read against each other.

runs_over.description: Whether the average runs as far over the planned length as ops set (technician_work.over_by, 15 minutes to begin with); false when the phone timed none of the jobs.

skill.description: The board's "First fit" or "Service". Nothing records what a technician is trained for and the FSM user carries no such field, so this is always null (docs/open-points.md, item 59).

source.description: The module the default lives in.

keys.description: null for one number, a list where the keys are fixed, "open" where ops name them.
